title: Superpositions of CARMA processes
summary: We introduce supCARMA processes, defined as superpositions of Lévy-driven CARMA processes with respect to a Lévy basis, as a natural extension of the superpositions of Ornstein-Uhlenbeck type processes. We then focus on supCAR$(2)$ processes and show that they can be classified into three distinct types determined by the eigenstructure of the underlying CAR$(2)$ matrix. For each type we provide conditions for existence and derive explicit expressions for the correlation function.
